```yaml
name: Third Party Updates

on:
  schedule:
    # Runs at 00:00 UTC every day
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  github-actions-update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Update GitHub Actions versions
        run: |
          # Update GitHub Actions versions in workflow files
          find .github/workflows -name "*.yml" -o -name "*.yaml" | xargs sed -i 's/uses: actions\/\([^@]*\)@[^"]*/uses: actions\/\1@latest/g'

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update GitHub Actions versions" || echo "No changes to commit"

      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@master
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: ${{ github.ref }}

  general-js-deps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Update JavaScript dependencies
        run: pnpm update

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update JavaScript dependencies" || echo "No changes to commit"

      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@master
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: ${{ github.ref }}
```
